subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Which Telegram agent-facing surface should own known forum topic-name to topic_id resolution for routing: an observed topic catalog/list action, a direct resolver, or context injection?
rationale: Current code has the observed id-to-name cache, but exposing reverse routing requires maintainer intent for stale data, duplicate titles, permissions, and whether the contract belongs in message actions or session context.

options.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

options.title: Add Resolver-Only Helper
options.body: Add a direct name-to-id helper that returns structured ambiguity for duplicate or stale names instead of routing silently.

options.title: Keep Manual IDs For Now
options.body: Keep numeric topic ids as the only supported routing contract and document the workaround until a stronger Telegram product surface is chosen.

recommendation.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to both the topic-name cache refactor and Telegram action-surface history that would anchor the resolver contract.
